process.name: Credit Line Increase Request
process.description: Automated credit line increase: customer/agent submits via Coach View 'CLIR Customer Info Form', system risk rules auto-approve or auto-reject, high-risk cases go to underwriter review via Coach View 'CLIR Underwriter Review Form' with a 24-hour SLA escalation, Core Banking REST updates the limit, and an audit event is dispatched.

elements.name: Submit Credit Line Increase Request
elements.documentation: CSHS uses Coach View component 'CLIR Customer Info Form' (business-processes/coaches/coach-views/CLIR_CustomerInfoForm). Bind the Coach View to tw.local.customerInfo. Fields: customerID, fullName, creditScore, annualIncome, currentLimit, requestedIncrease. Client validate: annualIncome > 0; requestedIncrease > currentLimit; creditScore 300-850. On success sets customerInfo.status = SUBMITTED. Source: content.html + styles.css + handlers/load|view|change|validate.js.

elements.name: Risk Assessment Engine
elements.documentation: Server script / decision service flow. Rule 1: if creditScore < 650 -> riskLevel=AUTO_REJECT, autoApproved=false, riskReason='Credit score below minimum threshold', approvalDecision.status=REJECTED, processedBy='SYSTEM_RISK_ENGINE'. Rule 2: else if currentLimit > (annualIncome * 0.50) -> riskLevel=HIGH_RISK, autoApproved=false, riskReason='High exposure ratio', approvalDecision.status=PENDING_UNDERWRITER. Rule 3: else if requestedIncrease > (annualIncome + currentLimit) * 0.30 -> riskLevel=HIGH_RISK, autoApproved=false, riskReason='Requested increase exceeds 30% financial capacity', approvalDecision.status=PENDING_UNDERWRITER. Default: riskLevel=LOW_RISK, autoApproved=true, riskReason='Passed automated risk checks', approvalDecision.status=APPROVED, approvedAmount=requestedIncrease, processedBy='SYSTEM_RISK_ENGINE'.

elements.name: Risk Level?
elements.documentation: Routes on tw.local.riskAssessment.riskLevel. Values: AUTO_REJECT, LOW_RISK, HIGH_RISK.

elements.name: Update Credit Limit
elements.documentation: External Service (OpenAPI). POST https://api.bank.internal/v1/limits/update. Request: { accountHolderId: tw.local.customerInfo.customerID, newCreditLimit: tw.local.approvalDecision.approvedAmount || tw.local.customerInfo.requestedIncrease, approvalSource: tw.local.riskAssessment.autoApproved ? 'BAW_AUTO_APPROVAL' : 'BAW_UNDERWRITER_APPROVAL' }. Map HTTP 200 txStatus into tw.local.approvalDecision.status. Assumption: underwriter Approved also calls this REST (PDD ASCII only showed Core Banking on LOW_RISK path).

elements.name: Core Banking Failed
elements.documentation: Error boundary on Core Banking REST. Route to audit with rejected/error outcome for recovery visibility.

elements.name: Underwriter Manual Review
elements.documentation: CSHS uses Coach View component 'CLIR Underwriter Review Form' (business-processes/coaches/coach-views/CLIR_UnderwriterReviewForm). Bind Coach View to tw.local.approvalDecision; config-bind customerInfo -> tw.local.customerInfo and riskAssessment -> tw.local.riskAssessment (read-only). Capture status APPROVED/REJECTED, approvedAmount, approverComments, processedBy. Assign to team Underwriter_Group. SLA: 24-hour non-interrupting timer boundary. Source: content.html + styles.css + handlers/load|view|change|validate.js.

elements.name: Underwriter SLA 24h
elements.documentation: Non-interrupting timer. Duration: 24 hours (PT24H). On fire, trigger Manager Escalation Notification Email handler. Set timer duration in Process Designer after import.

elements.name: Manager Escalation Notify
elements.documentation: Sends manager escalation notification email for overdue underwriter review. Sets approvalDecision.status = ESCALATED (extended beyond PDD enum for routing) and customerInfo.status = ESCALATED.

elements.name: Underwriter Outcome?
elements.documentation: Routes on tw.local.approvalDecision.status after underwriter review.

elements.name: Dispatch Audit Log
elements.documentation: Formats JSON audit payload with system timestamp, process instance ID, customerID, riskLevel, and final approvalDecision. Writes to system log and/or HTTP audit endpoint.

elements.name: Final Outcome?
elements.documentation: Routes to the named end event matching the terminal decision.

variables.name: customerInfo
variables.description: Primary credit line increase request payload captured at submission.

variables.name: riskAssessment
variables.description: Automated risk evaluation result from the Risk Assessment Engine.

variables.name: approvalDecision
variables.description: Final or intermediate approval decision set by rules, underwriter, or system.

businessObjects.name: CustomerInfo
businessObjects.description: Account-holder credit line request data. status values: SUBMITTED, IN_REVIEW, COMPLETED, ESCALATED. Validation: requestedIncrease > currentLimit; annualIncome > 0. creditScore range 300-850.

businessObjects.name: RiskAssessment
businessObjects.description: Automated risk engine output. riskLevel values: LOW_RISK, HIGH_RISK, AUTO_REJECT. status values: COMPLETE, ERROR.

businessObjects.name: ApprovalDecision
businessObjects.description: Decision record. status values: APPROVED, REJECTED, PENDING_UNDERWRITER, ESCALATED, INTEGRATION_ERROR. processedBy is user id or system service account.
